items.text: Genuine and boxed with the brand's own case, cloth and two-year guarantee.
Free UK delivery over £75, or collect in Birmingham and I'll adjust them to fit while you wait.
Adjustments, tightening and re-fitting are free for as long as you own them.

attributes.text: Across one lens at its widest, rim to rim.
The gap between the lenses, where the frame sits on your nose.
The arm, from the hinge to the tip, ear bend included.

attributes.title: Will prescription lenses work in these?

attributes.text: Yes — single vision or varifocal. Frames with a strong curve suit prescriptions up to about ±4.00 best. I check yours before cutting anything and will suggest an alternative if this pair isn't the one.
The frame, the brand's own hard case, a cleaning cloth and the manufacturer's warranty card. Nothing is unboxed, resealed or third-party.
Free UK delivery over £75, otherwise £3.95 tracked. Free collection in Birmingham. 30 days to return unworn frames; prescription lenses are refundable only if I got them wrong.
Bring them in any time and I'll straighten, tighten or re-fit them for nothing, whether you bought them here last week or last year.
No reviews on this frame yet — it's new to the shop.
Buy this pair and you can be the first to review it.

reviews.author: Anonymous M.
reviews.text: Had a lovely experience taking my daughter here. The optician Fatima is very good with children and made the experience enjoyable for my daughter. The receptionist was also very welcoming.

reviews.author: Neelum Mushtaq
reviews.text: Took my mum as emergency appointment. A day before spoke to fatima on call, fatima also did a video call for my mum. Got an urgent appointment next morning. Explained next few steps and booked my mum for a follow up appointment for a next week. Highly recommended, great service. 👍

reviews.author: Hanif Ur-Rehman
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of being a patient of Ward End Eye Care since it first opened a few years ago. I have been extremely impressed by Fatima (the optician), as she has always ensured that she thoroughly checks my eyes during my eye tests. The equipment that Fatima uses is state of the art and the health of her patients is paramount.

reviews.author: Sadia K
reviews.text: Wow very kind and knows how to treat children of all ages. They will aways fit you in and Fatimah the optometrist will go above and beyond to help with you eye check ups. Definitely recommend

reviews.author: Ajmal Mohammed
reviews.text: The best optician in birmingham, great customer service from the whole team. Went out they way to see me and my mum and gave great advice.

reviews.author: Aamer
reviews.text: Optician was very knowledgable and friendly. Appointment was on time and thorough. Overall a great customer experience.
